snippet.title: Alternatis - William the Conqueror - Demo out!
snippet.description:
Play the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4911810/Alternatis__William_the_Conqueror

Take on the role of William the Conqueror, choose one of the many historical or alternate-history paths, make the boldest or the wisest strategic decisions, and shape the fate of your kingdom and Europe as a whole!
